primary_endpoint.candidate_comparison: B1 vs B0 (paired on the same observation; B0 is the paired baseline)
primary_endpoint.decision_rule: B1 primary confirmation requires all of: (1) paired false-rejection risk difference (B1-B0) < 0; (2) paired valid supported coverage increases (B1 > B0); (3) zero claim-integrity violations for B1 (all claim statuses within {supported_conditional, undetermined, contradicted}; no supported_invariant); (4) the detection non-inferiority rule below holds. The evaluator numeric primary_result checks (1) and (4); (2) and (3) are mandatory pre-declared guardrails reported as secondary metrics and must both hold for confirmation.
primary_endpoint.definition: On identical paired sealed-grid observations, B1 vs B0: increase correct-CV valid supported coverage (equivalently reduce correct-CV false rejection) without losing acceleration discrepancy detection beyond the pre-registered bound. Supported coverage is the fraction of truth-correct correct-CV trials whose candidate record is validly supported by the frozen C1 claim gate.
primary_endpoint.detection_non_inferiority_rule: Paired acceleration discrepancy-detected risk difference (B1-B0) >= -0.10 (detection_loss_bound), under undecided_policy=not_detected: an undetermined acceleration trial is not counted as detected. The alternative excluded-policy analysis is a reported sensitivity, not the primary rule.
primary_endpoint.final_confirmation_rule: Confirmation requires all of: evaluator primary_result == pass; the two-sided 95% paired Wald interval for the supported-coverage risk difference has lower bound > 0; paired false-rejection risk difference (B1-B0) <= 0; zero claim-integrity violations for B1 (all claim statuses in the frozen C1 allowed set; no supported_invariant). Otherwise the pre-defined negative-result statement applies. The evaluator reports these components; the Lead applies the final rule on the single sealed run.
primary_endpoint.multiplicity: single pre-declared primary comparison; all other endpoints are secondary and descriptive, with no alpha adjustment claimed
primary_endpoint.name: correct_cv_supported_coverage_and_detection_B1_vs_B0
primary_endpoint.numeric_evaluation_rule: evaluator primary_result: paired supported-coverage risk difference (B1-B0) > 0 and paired acceleration discrepancy-detected risk difference >= -detection_loss_bound under undecided_policy=not_detected; alternative excluded-policy analysis reported as sensitivity

sealed_runner.note: The runner verifies this manifest digest, every dependency hash and frozen digest before loading the grid; no frozen parameter is retuned after the run.
sealed_runner.program:
import hashlib, json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path.cwd()
MANIFEST_PATH = REPO / "protocols/c2c-freeze-v1.json"
GRID_PATH = REPO / "protocols/c2c-grid-v1.json"
OUT_DIR = Path("/tmp/c2-repair-sealed-v1")
VERIFY_ONLY = "--verify-only" in sys.argv

def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")

raw = MANIFEST_PATH.read_bytes()
document = json.loads(raw)
declared = document.pop("frozen_manifest_digest")
computed = hashlib.sha256(canonical(document)).hexdigest()
if declared != computed:
    raise SystemExit(f"manifest digest mismatch: declared {declared}, computed {computed}")
print(f"manifest_digest: {computed}")
print(f"status: {document['status']}")

for item in document["dependencies"]["files"]:
    path = REPO / item["path"]
    actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if actual != item["sha256"]:
        raise SystemExit(f"dependency hash mismatch for {item['path']}: {actual} != {item['sha256']}")
print(f"dependency_hashes_ok: {len(document['dependencies']['files'])}")

from phaino_acoustics import adequacy_protocol
if adequacy_protocol.PROTOCOL_DIGEST != document["adequacy_protocol"]["protocol_digest"]:
    raise SystemExit("frozen adequacy protocol digest mismatch")
from phaino_claims.claims_protocol import load_protocol, verify_protocol_digest
claims = load_protocol(str(REPO / document["claim_gate"]["protocol_path"]))
if not verify_protocol_digest(claims):
    raise SystemExit("frozen C1 claims protocol self-digest mismatch")
if claims["protocol_digest"] != document["claim_gate"]["protocol_digest"]:
    raise SystemExit("frozen C1 claims protocol digest mismatch")
from phaino_acoustics.experiment_repair import (
    PRIMARY_ENDPOINT, UNDECIDED_POLICY, DETECTION_LOSS_BOUND,
    canonical_digest, gate_policy_document, run_repair,
)
for key in (
    "name",
    "definition",
    "candidate_comparison",
    "decision_rule",
    "detection_non_inferiority_rule",
    "primary_metric",
):
    if canonical(PRIMARY_ENDPOINT.get(key)) != canonical(document["primary_endpoint"].get(key)):
        raise SystemExit(f"primary endpoint field {key!r} differs from frozen implementation")
if UNDECIDED_POLICY != document["undecided_policy"]:
    raise SystemExit("undecided policy differs from frozen implementation")
if abs(float(DETECTION_LOSS_BOUND) - float(document["detection_loss_bound"])) > 0.0:
    raise SystemExit("detection loss bound differs from frozen implementation")
if canonical_digest(gate_policy_document(claims)) != document["claim_gate"]["gate_policy_digest"]:
    raise SystemExit("gate policy digest mismatch")
from phaino_acoustics.measurement_model import measurement_model_record
if canonical_digest(measurement_model_record()) != document["measurement_model"]["record_digest"]:
    raise SystemExit("measurement-model record digest mismatch")
from phaino_acoustics.experiment_repair import (
    CAL_TRIALS_PER_CONDITION as CAL_N,
    CALIBRATION_SEED_BASE as CAL_SEED,
    build_calibration_conditions,
)
cal_conditions = build_calibration_conditions()
calibration_definition = {
    "seed_base": CAL_SEED,
    "seed_formula": "SEED_BASE + 1000*condition_index + trial",
    "trials_per_condition": CAL_N,
    "total_trials": sum(int(c["n_trials"]) for c in cal_conditions),
    "conditions": cal_conditions,
    "inclusion_rule": (
        "correct-model calibration trial with converged optimization, finite positive "
        "sigma_f and finite adequacy statistics; no truth or label used"
    ),
}
if canonical_digest(calibration_definition) != document["calibration"]["sample_definition_digest"]:
    raise SystemExit("calibration sample-definition digest mismatch")
print("frozen protocol and calibration digests ok")

if VERIFY_ONLY:
    print("verify_only: preflight passed; sealed grid not opened")
    raise SystemExit(0)

if (OUT_DIR / "c2-repair.json").exists():
    raise SystemExit("single-run rule: sealed artifact already exists; do not rerun")

import phaino_acoustics.c2_grid as grid_module
grid = grid_module.load_grid(str(GRID_PATH))
sealed = document["sealed_grid"]
if grid["grid_id"] != sealed["grid_id"]:
    raise SystemExit("sealed grid id mismatch")
if grid["grid_digest"] != sealed["declared_grid_digest"]:
    raise SystemExit("sealed grid definition digest mismatch")
if grid_module.trial_count(grid) != int(sealed["declared_trial_count"]):
    raise SystemExit("sealed grid trial count mismatch")
FAMILY_TO_MECHANISM = {
    "cv_continuum": "correct_cv",
    "cv_continuum_low_snr": "correct_cv",
    "acceleration_continuum": "acceleration",
    "null": "null",
}
SEED_BASE = int(sealed["declared_seed_base"])
conditions = []
for condition in grid["conditions"]:
    family = condition["family"]
    if family not in FAMILY_TO_MECHANISM:
        raise SystemExit(f"unknown sealed-grid family {family!r}")
    index = int(condition["condition_index"])
    converted = {
        "condition_index": index,
        "name": condition["name"],
        "mechanism": FAMILY_TO_MECHANISM[family],
        "stratum": condition["stratum"],
        "n_trials": int(condition["n_trials"]),
        "seed_base": SEED_BASE,
        "label": condition.get("label", ""),
        "scenario": dict(condition["scenario"]),
    }
    for trial in (0, int(condition["n_trials"]) - 1):
        expected = SEED_BASE + 1000 * index + trial
        actual = grid_module.condition_seed(condition, trial)
        if expected != actual:
            raise SystemExit(f"seed mapping mismatch for {condition['name']}: {expected} != {actual}")
    conditions.append(converted)
sealed_grid = dict(grid)
sealed_grid.update({
    "development_grid": False,
    "sealed_grid_used": True,
    "sealed_grid_opened": True,
    "c2_diagnosis_seeds_reused": False,
})
jobs = min(8, os.cpu_count() or 1)
result = run_repair(
    jobs=jobs,
    condition_override=conditions,
    grid_override=sealed_grid,
    output_dir=str(OUT_DIR),
    quiet=True,
)
artifact = result["artifact"]
if artifact["grid_id"] != sealed["grid_id"]:
    raise SystemExit("artifact grid id mismatch")
if artifact["frozen_grid_digest"] != sealed["declared_grid_digest"]:
    raise SystemExit("artifact frozen grid digest mismatch")
from phaino_c2_eval.artifacts import load_artifact
loaded = load_artifact(result["artifact_path"])
if loaded.primary_endpoint["name"] != document["primary_endpoint"]["name"]:
    raise SystemExit("artifact primary endpoint mismatch")
run_record = {
    "manifest_digest": computed,
    "manifest_path": str(MANIFEST_PATH),
    "artifact_path": result["artifact_path"],
    "artifact_sha256": result["artifact_sha256"],
    "grid_id": artifact["grid_id"],
    "frozen_grid_digest": artifact["frozen_grid_digest"],
    "protocol_digest": artifact["protocol_digest"],
    "environment_id": artifact["environment_id"],
    "trials": len(artifact["trials"]),
    "jobs": jobs,
    "sealed_run_count": 1,
    "note": "first and only sealed run for this frozen manifest; no rerun for a better result",
}
(OUT_DIR / "run-record.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(run_record, indent=1, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
)
print(f"artifact: {result['artifact_path']}")
print(f"artifact_sha256: {result['artifact_sha256']}")
print(f"protocol_digest: {artifact['protocol_digest']}")
print(f"grid: {artifact['grid_id']} {artifact['frozen_grid_digest']}")
print(f"environment_id: {artifact['environment_id']}")
print(f"trials: {len(artifact['trials'])}")
sealed_runner.run_command: PYTHONPATH=python python3 -  # pipe program below; executes exactly once

The sealed grid file itself was not opened or hashed in stage 1 (sealing); only the accepted declared grid digest/count/seed base are recorded. The frozen runner verifies them against the file exactly once at run.

ADR 0023 B selfcheck exists and is referenced by digest; its time-block-holdout finding must be adjudicated by the Lead as part of the conditional approval. This manifest does not convert that development finding into acceptance.
B3's SNR conditioning branch is unverified: the calibration sample has zero admissible trials in the low estimated-SNR reporting bin, so the artifact declares that branch unexercised (ADR 0023 C).
The C2-M2 M3 error model has no separate semantic version field; its acceptance-contract version/digest is declared in the C2-M2 report and not recomputed here. It is not used by B0-B3.
Cross-platform reproducibility of repair artifacts is not frozen or claimed; only environment_id is recorded per artifact.
No repository commit hash is available (git operations were not performed); authority documents are frozen by working-tree sha256 instead of a commit id.
The development report (`docs/experiments/2026-11-05-c2-repair-dev.md`) still cites the pre-metadata-update artifact sha; docs were not edited in stage 1 (reconciliation listed above).
The sealed runner is an inline program frozen by hash rather than a committed file; if the Lead prefers a file, this manifest must be revised.
Development-derived B2/B3 calibration reference floats are environment-dependent; the sealed run recomputes calibration from the frozen sample and any difference is reported, not retuned.
